segments.contextBefore: Like all SwiftUI views, forms display their content in a platform-appropriate way.
segments.contextAfter: For example, a [`Picker`](picker.md) control in a [`Form`](form.md) on iOS adds navigation, showing the picker’s choices on a separate screen, while the same [`Picker`](picker.md) on macOS displays a pop-up button or set of radio buttons.
